name: reel-a-field-guide-tournament-grandparent
head: THE TOURNAMENT
GRANDPARENT

entries.label: HABITAT
entries.text: Top row of the bleachers, under a blanket older than the coach.

entries.label: DIET
entries.text: Rink hot chocolate. Crackers from a purse that holds everything.

entries.label: HOW TO SPOT
entries.text: Cheers for every save. Both goalies.

entries.label: BEHAVIOR
entries.text: Drove four hours. Up for the 7 AM game anyway.

end: Has never once left before the handshake line.
follow: Follow for more from the rink.
